text:
sahil: Heads up - NationalLedger wants an on-prem air-gapped POC. Key asks: SBOM + signed artifacts, HSM-compatible key import, documented chain-of-custody for physical media, and a clearly called-out upgrade cadence in the SOW. Who can confirm what we can promise?

rebecca: We can produce a signed SBOM (CycloneDX) and sign bundles with our code-signing key. If they require their own HSM to host the signing key we support importing a pubkey for verification only; we do not ship private keys. Need to check if they want us to sign with their imported key or just provide the signed artifact and verification steps.

tony: From ops: two delivery profiles we offer:
- "Full bundle": operator images + runtime + model snapshots (single tar ~30-80GB).
- "Delta minibundles": model deltas + manifest (typically <5GB) for faster patching.
Lead times: Full bundle build + signing ~3 business days after final manifest; minibundle ~1 business day. Courier chain-of-custody add ~2-5 days depending on region.

legal: They flagged telemetry and retention in the questionnaire. They want no outbound beacons and explicit retention windows for logs. We can deliver a no-telemetry build and commit to a max 90-day retention for local logs, but legal wants the SOW to include what support looks like without remote telemetry. Recommend adding an on-site diagnostics & support hours line item.

rebecca: Verification checklist we can hand them (concise):
- Validate sha256 of bundle matches manifest
- Verify signature: openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature redwood-bundle.sig redwood-bundle.tar.gz
- Validate SBOM matches artifact (cyclonedx-cli sbom verify)
- Confirm FIPS mode if requested (container runtime flag)
- Install dry-run on isolated node, run smoke tests
- Confirm telemetry flag present and disabled in config.yaml

sahil: Can you paste the exact commands we give SecOps? want to include in PR FAQ email.

rebecca: Sure, sample commands:

```
sha256sum redwood-bundle-2026-03-01.tar.gz
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature redwood-bundle-2026-03-01.sig redwood-bundle-2026-03-01.tar.gz
cyclonedx-cli verify --sbom redwood-bundle-2026-03-01-sbom.json --artifact redwood-bundle-2026-03-01.tar.gz
cat manifest.json | jq '.images[] | {name, digest}'
```

tony: Also note: signer key rotation -> requires re-sign of active bundles. If they insist on customer-managed signing keys in HSM, our ops cost increases (we need partner coordination + secure key import rehearsal). Expect +20% uplift on packaging fee.

legal: Addendum: include a clause that emergency hotfixes for critical CVEs can be delivered as signed minibundles within 48 hours after acknowledgement (if customer buys hotfix SLA). Otherwise standard cadence applies.

sahil: Pricing model we plan to propose:
- One-time packaging + signing fee (includes SBOM and manifest): $XXk
- Monthly retainer for patch generation & verification + courier coordination: $Yk/mo
- Emergency hotfix SLA (48h): separate line item (flat fee per incident or subscription)
- HSM integration / customer key import: professional services day-rate as needed

rebecca: Ops notes to include in email: tamper-evident seals, serial-numbered USBs, paper chain-of-custody document, and shipping manifest. Recommend insurance for high-value deliveries.

tonY: small gotcha: delta minibundles require operator version pinning. We'll include an 'operator-compatibility' section in the manifest.

ops-bot: Created ticket POC-NL-2026 and attached internal runbook template. Assigned to rebecca + tony.

sahil: Great. I'll draft the SecOps email with the checklist + sample commands + pricing lines and ask them to select cadence: monthly deltas vs quarterly fulls. If they pick monthly, include retainer quote + hotfix SLA option.

legal: I'll prepare the no-beacon SOW language and options for log retention and on-site diagnostics.

rebecca: One more: if they insist on air-gap plus offline telemetry ingestion (i.e., periodic upload), we can offer an encrypted telemetry bundle export process. That should be a separate option in SOW.

sahil: Perfect. Closing thread after draft sent. :white_check_mark:
